## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmed by cyclicals leading (JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND) and broad sector gains alongside a tech-led spike; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials and Financials strong: ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND and XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Communication showing weakness and dispersion; Technology showing internal split with big winners and many large-cap losers (IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.68% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -13.74% | 1M: -15.53%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in enterprise software/large-cap tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present—multiple large caps with 1W/1M mismatch (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) — watch for trend break; treat moves as tactical follow-through rather than automatic core rotation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but heavy upside at the top: NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, while IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion; overall Technology up on a concentrated leadership run.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive and confirming RISK-ON: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector gains support cyclical risk appetite; V (1W: +1.18% | 1M: -1.49%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL—monitor follow-through.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/defensive tilt but selective strength: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL—watch for idiosyncratic catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure (JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak enterprise software/high-multiple names (NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.68% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical emphasis given broad cyclical leadership despite concentrated tech winners.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND), Industrials (ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND), Financials (JPM ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy (PSX BELOW TREND, XOM TREND EXHAUSTION) and Communication for dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND — need follow-through above recent highs to confirm broad tech carry. AAPL (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -0.13%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — hold 1W gains to validate reversal. JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND — sustained strength would reinforce cyclical rotation. INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for mean-reversion after outsized spike.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+60): UnitedHealth (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — news confirming price action. CVX (+60): Chevron (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price diverging (distribution risk). LLY (+55): Eli Lilly (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sentiment positive, watch follow-through. MPC (+55): Marathon Petroleum (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND — upbeat news but price lagging. TSLA (+50): Tesla (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND — analyst optimism, price not confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-55): Phillips 66 (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment aligning with weak price action. CVX (-50): Chevron flagged (alternate headline) (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines and price weakness create downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt. JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) and mixed sentiment in Energy (CVX bullish headlines but price BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation.
